events.event: Silicon Valley Bank (SVB) collapsed and was seized by regulators
events.answer: On March 10, 2023, the United States Department of the Treasury, the Federal Reserve, and the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) announced that they had seized the assets of Silicon Valley Bank (SVB) and placed it into receivership. This marked the second-largest bank failure in U.S. history at the time.
